_doc: First-pick table for the B1 policy (agent/pokemon/draft.py first_pick_adjust / first_pick_bonus), in log-odds (the draft search's unit). adjust: species -> log-odds in either draft order; adjust_we_first / adjust_they_first: added only in that draft order; pairs: "A + B" -> log-odds added to B at our second pick when A is our first pick (and vice versa). Every entry is applied in full at our first pick and half at our second, never after, times the tuning key draft_first_adjust_w. All zeros = the stage2 draft exactly. For a simulator A/B arm, DRAFT_FIRST_PICK_ADJUST=<path to a file of this shape> replaces this table in that process. Missing cards count as 0.
